title: Weekly Puzzle #46 – The Princess Diaries
selftext:
This week's puzzle uses the [newly-revealed Princess](https://www.reddit.com/r/BloodOnTheClocktower/comments/1li31ya/new_character_princess/)!

Please put proposed solutions behind spoiler markup (> and ! at start, then ! and < at end).

Huge thanks to the folks on the [Unofficial Discord's puzzle channel](https://discord.com/channels/569683781800296501/854891541969109033) for their help with playtesting!

[Previous weekly puzzles are archived here.](https://notquitetangible.blogspot.com/2024/11/clocktower-puzzle-archive.html)
